mapper.select: SELECT feature.feature_key, domain.id AS domain_id, domain.name AS domain_name, application.id AS app_id, application.name AS app_name FROM t_sys_feature feature INNER JOIN t_sys_app application ON application.id = feature.app_id INNER JOIN t_sys_domain domain ON domain.id = application.domain_id WHERE feature.feature_key IN #{featureKey} ORDER BY domain.seq, domain.id, application.seq, application.id, COALESCE(feature.custom_seq, feature.default_seq), feature.id
mapper.sql: a.id, a.version, a.feature_key, a.app_id, b.name AS app_name, b.domain_id, c.name AS domain_name, a.default_name, a.custom_name, COALESCE(a.custom_name, a.default_name) AS name, a.default_seq, a.custom_seq, COALESCE(a.custom_seq, a.default_seq) AS seq, a.description, a.visible, a.source

SELECT FROM t_sys_feature a INNER JOIN t_sys_app b ON b.id = a.app_id INNER JOIN t_sys_domain c ON c.id = b.domain_id
a.app_id = #{form.appId} b.domain_id = #{form.domainId}
AND (a.feature_key LIKE CONCAT('%', #{form.keyword}, '%') OR a.default_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{form.keyword}, '%') OR a.custom_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{form.keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY ${listQuery.sortColumn} ${listQuery.sortOrder}, a.id ORDER BY c.seq, b.seq, COALESCE(a.custom_seq, a.default_seq), a.id
